package unformatted

import "time"

// waits holds the shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the pattern still judges.
func waits() {
	select { // reported, fixed: parentheses doubled around the receive
	case ((<-time.After(0))):
	}
	select { // reported, fixed: parentheses doubled around the call and tripled around the argument
	case <-((time.After(((0))))):
	}
	select { // reported, no fix: the lone semicolon is an empty statement, and the body holds it
	case <-time.After(0): ;
	}
}
